title: BeHealth Digital — Technical SEO Review
description: Independent technical-SEO review of behealthdigital.com by Mousa Batarseh — every canonical points to a 404 staging host, no case studies, and a client audit. For the SEO Specialist role.

blocks.text: SEC. 01 — OVERVIEW · FOR THE SEO SPECIALIST ROLE
Your own site tells Google it lives somewhere else.

Every page on behealthdigital.com — its canonical, its og:url, its sitemap entry and the Organization schema's @id — points to wellspring-web-make.lovable.app, a staging host that returns 404 “No published build.” The agency is telling search engines its real pages are duplicates of nothing. That's the first thing an SEO Specialist would fix — then run the same audit on every client.
signals pointing off-site: canonical, og:url, sitemap, schema @id
images with alt text on the flagship client's site
The cheapest authority recovery available — one find-and-replace across the build, plus a regenerated sitemap.
“$42M+ revenue managed,” “14k+ admissions,” and /case-studies is a 404. In behavioral health, E-E-A-T needs receipts.
The client the agency showcases first: a 162-character title, two H1s, 77 of 80 images without alt, an empty MedicalClinic @id.
Independent — not affiliated with BeHealth Digital
